'''Nworb Yorel''', best known as '''Big Nworb Yorel the Bad''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a member of the [[Canopy bandits]], a criminal group that operated from a [[Canopy bandit's camp|camp]] in the region of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. A tall man, Nworb Yorel had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic arm]] replacing his right arm and was known to often wear the helmet of a [[Rebel heavy battle armor/Legends|Rebel battle armor]] to hide his face.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Big Nworb Yorel the Bad was present in the Canopy bandit's camp when it was attacked by a group of spacers.<ref name="SWG:TMR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|The Missing Researchers|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NworbYorel.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Emulated depiction of Nworb Yorel without helmet.]]
Nworb Yorel appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Big Nworb Yorel the Bad was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

In the game, Big Nworb Yorel the Bad was present in the Canopy bandit's camp on Kashyyyk.<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> The camp was featured in the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Missing Researchers|The Missing Researchers]]" but Big Nworb Yorel the Bad was not involved in the quest,<ref name="SWG:TMR" /> nor in any other quest.<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> Big Nworb Yorel the Bad was known in games files as "ep3_canopy_boss", suggesting that this character was intended to be the leader of the Canopy bandits.<ref name="File">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' &mdash; ep3_canopy_boss.tpf</ref>
